name: tsa_getRestaurants
description: Returns all active restaurants (isActive = 1) ordered by name for the browse page. Public data; called by GET. Does not return phone or portalPassword. Called by the TSA Eats Next.js app (tsa-eats/lib/api.ts) through api/Endpoints/TsaApi.cs, which maps queryType 'getRestaurants' to [TSA].[tsa_getRestaurants]. There is no Harrier Central auth: POST requires the shared X-Api-Key (TsaApiKey); GET requires nothing, and the shim does not restrict which procedure a GET may name. The shim turns any one-row rowset with Success = 0 into HTTP 400 {success:false, errorMessage}, and an empty first rowset into HTTP 404.

rowsets.name: Restaurants
rowsets.description: Zero or more rows ordered by name.

codeSmells.issue: SP body not wrapped in TRY/CATCH
codeSmells.detail: Read procedure with no TRY/CATCH: any runtime error (timeout, deadlock) becomes an unlogged raw 500 from the shim.
serviceTypes is comma-separated (TSA.Restaurant table header); CLAUDE.md asks for '|'.
